verdict.rationale: Codex cloud documents running tasks in isolated cloud environments in parallel. You can delegate longer tasks and return when they're ready, and the CLI can split work across specialized subagents. Nothing shows agents running autonomously for hours or days, or launching large fleets at scale. missing for 10: evidence of multi-hour/multi-day autonomous runtimes, documented fleet-scale concurrency limits or orchestration, independent hands-on corroboration of long-running parallel agent fleets

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days

citations.quote: Run tasks in isolated cloud environments, work in parallel
Run tasks in parallel without tying up your local machine.
Delegate a longer task and return when it is ready.
Ask Codex to delegate focused work to specialized agents, then bring their findings back into the main terminal session.
